test_title: PYST 09: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the followings is NOT one of the government accounts of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**General Provident Fund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **General Provident Fund:**

 
 
• The General Provident Fund (GPF) is a savings scheme for government employees.
 
• It is a contributory provident fund where employees contribute a portion of their salary, and the government pays interest on the accumulated amount.
 
• While the government manages the GPF, it is not considered one of the core government accounts like the Consolidated Fund, Contingency Fund, or Public Accounts.
 
• It is a fund for government employees retirement.
 
• The money in the GPF belongs to the individual government employees.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public Accounts of India:**

 
 
• The Public Accounts of India is where funds that do not belong to the government are kept.
 
• These include funds from small savings, provident funds, and other deposits.
 
• The government acts as a banker for these funds.
 
• The government does not have direct control over these funds.
 
• The funds are refundable to the depositor.
 
 
 
• **Consolidated Fund of India:**
 
 
• The Consolidated Fund of India is the most important government account.
 
• All government revenues, loans, and expenditures are routed through this fund.
 
• No money can be withdrawn from this fund without parliamentary approval.
 
• It is the primary source of funds for the government's operations.
 
• It is created by article 266 of the constitution.
 
 
 
• **Contingency Fund of India:**
 
 
• The Contingency Fund of India is used for unforeseen expenditures.
 
• It is at the disposal of the President of India.
 
• It is used for emergency situations.
 
• It is created by article 267 of the constitution.
 
• Parliamentary approval is sought after the expenditure
